brief: Little hexagon pieces that snap together and pull apart, for my nine-month-old to play with on the floor.

requirements.evidence: 3x piece full (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) each ~191mm across, flat floor-level single storey, tops closed with full covers
requirements.requirement: Little hexagon pieces for floor play

requirements.evidence: 2x side-connector-single (connector:0#0,0|0,1 and 0#0,0|1,0); check_build groups show [0,1+1,0] joined and [0,0] separate, demonstrating join/separate; lockJoints deliberately omitted so baby/caregiver can pull apart

Single-storey build with solid top covers and capOpenFaces on 12 open faces; no small props added to avoid choking staging. Configurator checks fit/collisions only (meshClash clear) and knows nothing about material toxicity, mouthing/chewing strength, choking certification, or dishwasher safety.

finish.summary: Built 3 large hex pucks with easy single connectors: 2 snapped together, 1 separate to show pull-apart. Tops covered and edges capped, joints left unlocked for pull-apart. Infant mouthing/chewing, choking, material and cleaning safety cannot be verified here and remain unmet - caregiver supervision and appropriate filament choice required.

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
